app.name: TodoMVC (jQuery)
app.description: The 2012 jQuery and Handlebars implementation of TodoMVC, vendored from tastejs/todomvc.

behaviors.title: Add an item
behaviors.objective: Type Buy milk into the new todo field and submit it. Check the list now shows exactly one item named Buy milk and the input is empty again.

behaviors.title: New items keep their order
behaviors.objective: Add the items Buy milk, Walk the dog and Pay rent in that order. Check the list shows them top to bottom in the same order.

behaviors.title: Empty input is ignored
behaviors.objective: Submit the new todo field while it is empty, then submit it with only spaces. Check that no item was added to the list.

behaviors.title: Whitespace is trimmed
behaviors.objective: Add an item typed as two spaces, Buy milk, then two spaces. Check the stored item text is Buy milk with no leading or trailing spaces.

behaviors.title: Counter reads 1 item left
behaviors.objective: Add one item. Check the footer counter reads 1 item left, using the singular word item.

behaviors.title: Counter pluralizes
behaviors.objective: Add two items. Check the footer counter reads 2 items left, then complete one and check it reads 1 item left.

behaviors.title: Complete an item
behaviors.objective: Add Buy milk and mark it as completed. Check the item shows as completed and the counter reads 0 items left.

behaviors.title: Complete all at once
behaviors.objective: Add three items and use the control that marks all items as completed. Check every item shows as completed.

behaviors.title: Reopen all at once
behaviors.objective: Add three items, mark all as completed, then use the same control again. Check every item is active again and the counter reads 3 items left.

behaviors.title: Edit an item
behaviors.objective: Add Buy milk, open it for editing, replace the text with Buy oat milk and confirm. Check the list shows Buy oat milk.

behaviors.title: Cancel an edit
behaviors.objective: Add Buy milk, open it for editing, type different text, then cancel the edit. Check the item still reads Buy milk.

behaviors.title: Emptying an edit deletes
behaviors.objective: Add Buy milk, open it for editing, clear all of its text and confirm. Check the item was removed from the list.

behaviors.title: Delete an item
behaviors.objective: Add Buy milk and Walk the dog, then delete Buy milk. Check only Walk the dog remains.

behaviors.title: Clear completed
behaviors.objective: Add two items, complete one, and use Clear completed. Check only the active item remains and the Clear completed control is gone.

behaviors.title: Active filter
behaviors.objective: Add two items, complete one, and switch to the Active filter. Check only the uncompleted item is listed and the route reflects the filter.

behaviors.title: Completed filter
behaviors.objective: Add two items, complete one, and switch to the Completed filter. Check only the completed item is listed.

behaviors.title: Footer hides when empty
behaviors.objective: With no items, check the footer and the mark all control are not shown. Add one item and check both appear.

behaviors.title: Items survive a reload
behaviors.objective: Add Buy milk and Walk the dog, complete Walk the dog, then fully reload or relaunch the app. Check both items are still there with the same completed state.

rounds.feedback:
4 of 18 behaviors failed on Next.js.

trim-whitespace
  Step 3: Label reads '  Buy milk  '
  Reason: Leading and trailing spaces were kept.
  Root cause: The submit handler checks for empty input but stores the untrimmed value.
  Suggested fix: Trim the value before both the empty check and the insert.

edit-cancel
  Step 4: Pressed Escape; the edit field stayed open
  Reason: Cancelling the edit did not close the editor or restore the text.
  Root cause: The edit input handles Enter and blur but has no Escape handler.
  Suggested fix: On Escape, restore the original title and leave edit mode without saving.

edit-empty-deletes
  Step 3: Confirmed an empty edit; item still listed with no text
  Reason: An item with an empty title remained in the list.
  Root cause: Save path writes the trimmed value without checking for an empty string.
  Suggested fix: When the trimmed edit is empty, delete the item instead of saving it.

persist-reload
  Step 4: After reload the list is empty
  Reason: Items did not survive a full page reload.
  Root cause: State lives only in React memory; nothing is written to localStorage.
  Suggested fix: Persist todos to localStorage under todos-jquery and hydrate on mount.
